svg.text: South window 0 · local metal reveal-return enquiry
Schematic, not to scale. The actual frame, weather seal and air/gas join are not selected.
Arch curve schematic; actual profile and frame need binding.
1 mm jamb skin intrudes nominal opening
Two jamb skins leave 998 mm nominal
Red = conceptual sheet and reveal; no unqualified seal
or movement allowance is hidden at the frame.
40 mm × nominal perimeter ≈0.233 m² or ≈1.84 kg of 1 mm metal at 7900 kg/m³, before seams and waste.
Sill/wall water path, jamb/head bearing, fixation, welds, thermal bridge, fire and repair are unresolved.
A single window enquiry cannot establish continuity at other windows, doors, the roof, services or the court.
